title: Stoner
author: John Williams
summary: The life of William Stoner, a farm boy who goes to university and becomes an English teacher. It follows a quiet career, a disappointing marriage and small private joys, told in clear, calm prose.
readIf: you like quiet, sad novels about an ordinary life and what makes it count.
skipIf: you want plot twists or momentum, since almost nothing dramatic happens.

pairings.reason: A restrained story about a man looking back on a life of duty and missed chances.
A set of linked stories about a prickly, ordinary woman, equally honest and understated.
A warmer, funnier take on an isolated older man and the life that shaped him.
